address: 76/4 Nikorn Samran Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: The menu at this boiled rice spot boasts over 200 items, but the sour soup with deep-fried snakehead fish is a must. Like other dishes, it’s fresh, well-cooked and wallet friendly. Seating is available at two dining areas across the street from each other; closing time is midnight....
